title: The default docs environment enters the subsequent source distribution.
outcome: Strict docs passed using default in-checkout .venv-docs. Package checker failed during uv build with exit2: sdist contains .venv-docs/bin/python absolute external symlink. uv refuses to unpack an included virtual environment.
observed_scope: Previous author/reviewer commands deliberately used externally located docs environments. Their successful source/output-boundary proofs remain valid, but did not cover the documented in-checkout docs environment followed by package build.
required_fix: Exclude tool-created docs virtual environments from distributions, including .venv-docs and .venv-docs-bootstrap. Reproduce actual documented default docs→package sequence and uv-absent bootstrap variant with in-checkout environments. Verify clean sdist, Git-byte provenance, correct metadata, rebuild and installed wheel. Preserve prior output/source guards and fixtures. Root authorizes only narrow Hatch exclusion changes plus necessary regression evidence, no dependency/version/marker/lock changes.
separate_root_command_error: Initial bare ./docs/build.sh correctly rejected system Python3.9; root then used the documented explicit3.13 command. This initial prerequisite rejection is not a repository defect.
prior_gate: Conditional local deployment gate remains conditional; final-HEAD package condition failed. No deployment PR was published.
